assumptions: Acoustic layout only: no measured SPL benefit. Rear vent details and speaker fs/Vas/Qts are unavailable. Compare the removable lid on/off using the same signal and volume.
Dry hard-plastic prototype: no gasket, glue, or tape. Bare seat, lid joint, spring roots and wire exit can leak; not a sealed or tuned acoustic enclosure. Sound gain is unverified.
Battery model not chosen; prioritize thin rear. Select finished pack within checked envelope including protection and wrap.
Connector and plug depth remains conservative 5.5 mm, not physically measured.

MSK slider mechanical travel3.6 mm; socket play about0.65 mm for the supplied1.3 mm actuator, leaving up to2.95 mm actuator motion. Electrical end positions still require physical trial. Guide play is not a measured printer calibration.
Speaker tab shape is a conservative allowance from image; cable bending and plug strain relief require physical trial.
Board pocket2.15 mm is a non-clamping trial clearance; actual solder, warp and proud inserts are not in the source STEP. Do not force the joint with screws.
TF brow retains at least0.35 mm above checked card path; a small part of the lower PCB edge remains visible to preserve insertion clearance.
M2×2×3 insert interference with 2.8 mm pilot is intentional. Heat insertion fit requires trial.
slider_installation: vertical +Z to seated position; front removed; open socket captures actuator
acoustic_lid_attachment: printed fixed hook + two releasable cantilever latches; no adhesive or gasket

speaker_retention.type: two printed side springs; contact only rigid side frame
speaker_retention.material_note: PETG preferred for repeated disassembly; PLA trial allowed. Beam estimate is not fatigue/force validation.

wire_exit: 2.2 mm wide top-open notch; unsealed wire clearance; not a tuned port
acoustic_assembly_order: spread side springs and seat speaker on hard perimeter
lower opposite edge and snap two latches
check no rattle and no wire pinch
